summary: Newly published PMO chronology and Israeli television reporting indicate Netanyahu was alerted at 06:29 on October 7; the PMO chronology places his first full situational assessment with the defense minister and senior security chiefs, including the IDF chief, at 09:55. Channel 12 separately disputes the PMO's departure and arrival times and reports no direct security-chief calls before he reached the Kirya.
notes: The PMO's own schedule preserves important defense/context: it says Netanyahu received early updates through the military secretary, asked about reserve mobilization and targeting at 06:44, left at 07:30 and reached the Kirya around 08:00/08:22. Channel 12 says unpublished diary/source material indicates a materially later departure/arrival. Preserve Pending until the exact primary PMO chronology and/or original broadcast evidence is fully recovered and the operational-accountability significance can be resolved without inferring motive. This is distinct from canonical LEAD-2026-0002, which concerns Netanyahu's later claim of deliberate pre-attack withholding.
